decision: All landing zones deploy to a single region — the platform owns the region decision.
why: Without a single region, service parity depends on each engineer's choice rather than a platform default.

links.note: The region is a platform variable, not a team parameter — that is what makes the platform own it.
The region decision depends on runner VNet integration being available there.

violations: bicepparam with hardcoded location overrides workflow-injected region.
Platform region set to a region where GitHub runners VNet integration is unavailable.
